title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and hygiene updates
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: The repo has accumulated many near-duplicate GitHub Actions workflows for lint, unit tests, and release automation across packages and services. This PR consolidates the workflows into a small set of reusable templates to reduce maintenance, improve caching and parallelism, and make release automation more reliable. Goals: 1) Unify lint/test/release workflows into .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml} using reusable workflow call patterns, 2) Upgrade core CI actions (checkout/setup-node/cache) to their latest stable major versions and bump Node matrices to supported LTS versions, 3) Improve cache keys and restore behavior to reduce wasted CI minutes, 4) Stabilize flaky integration tests by adding retry hooks and conditional parallelism, 5) Repo hygiene: remove legacy per-package workflow fragments and update docs. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and add shared templates - [x] Update setup-node and cache actions to supported versions - [x] Standardize test matrix and parallelism policy - [x] Add retry and flake mitigation for flaky tests - [x] Run full CI across core repos and validate metrics Impact: CI runtime reduced ~18% on the main lint+test path in our initial sample runs. Release automation now supports semver-based tag generation and dry-run mode. Migration notes: Consumers of package-level workflows should remove old per-package workflow files; reusable workflow calls documented in CONTRIBUTING.md under "CI" section. Rollout: enabled on main, validated on redwood and redwood-sdk-python. See linked linear tickets for rollout plan and throttling policy.
commits: feat(ci): add reusable lint workflow template and call sites
fix(ci): improve cache keys and restore fallbacks for yarn and pip caches
perf(ci): reduce test matrix by focusing on LTS node versions and add parallel job throttling
chore(release): standardize release workflow with dry-run and canary flags
docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md with new workflows and migration steps
files_changed: .github/workflows/lint.yml - new reusable workflow that centralizes eslint and prettier runs using workflow_call pattern
.github/workflows/test.yml - consolidated test workflow with job matrix node: [18,20], os: [ubuntu-latest], includes integration job with retries and conditional parallelism
.github/workflows/release.yml - refactored release automation, adds dry-run and canary flags, uses actions/checkout@v4 and setup-node@v4
.github/workflows/templates/cache-setup.yml - added shared cache setup template to unify npm/yarn/pip cache keys
scripts/ci/cache.sh - small helper to compute deterministic cache keys for monorepo builds
CONTRIBUTING.md - updated CI section with migration steps and examples for calling reusable workflows
review_comments: Jordan Lee: Can we keep node 16 in the matrix for one more release cycle to support older customers? Ava Martinez: We measured negligible usage on node 16 in the last 6 months; kept a compatibility job in a weekly compatibility matrix instead of the default pull-request matrix.

Priya Nambiar: The cache key collision risk looked high for shared caches across packages. Please make keys package-scoped. Ava Martinez: Updated cache keys to include package path hash and lockfile checksum to avoid collisions.

Ethan Ruiz: Integration tests still flaked on CI run 3. Suggest adding a retry wrapper and collecting extra logs on failure. Ava Martinez: Added retry (3 attempts) and extra trace-level logs for failing cases; re-ran CI and green.
Jordan Lee: Approve after CI green and a smoke deploy of release workflow dry-run. Priya Nambiar: Approved. Ethan Ruiz: Approved.
ci_checks: integration-tests: passed after 1 rerun for flaky suite
e2e: skipped (not impacted by these changes)
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows; upgraded core GitHub Actions and Node matrix; improved caching and reduced CI minutes. No behavioral change to runtime code. Developers should remove legacy per-package workflows and follow CONTRIBUTING.md to call reusable workflows.
migration_steps: Remove legacy .github/workflows/*-per-package.yml files once all packages reference new templates
Update local CI debugging scripts to use scripts/ci/cache.sh for deterministic cache keys
Follow CONTRIBUTING.md examples to call .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml} from package-level workflows if needed
